$comment: Human-curated source for the Royal Route tour (task B1). Tour-level id, personaId, titles, summaries, fixedStartPoiId, fixedEndPoiId, estMinutes and per-stop poiId, dwellS, prize, triggerRadiusM, approachRadiusM mirror contracts/Model.ets Tour/TourStop; per-stop wikidataId, kind, names, lat, lng and view {look, feature} feed the Poi records in the pack build (B2). Every other key is review metadata for humans and is not emitted: $comment, summariesReview, namesSource, estMinutesBasis, coordinatesConfirmedBy, coordinateMethod, radiiNote, n, coordinateSource, coordinateCheck, view.basis, view.review. Coordinates, radii, dwell times, prizes and view hints are agent drafts until a human confirms them (coordinatesConfirmedBy, view.review).

summaries.en: The classic Royal Route through Kraków's Old Town: from the Barbican and St Florian's Gate across the Main Market Square, then along Grodzka and Kanonicza streets up to Wawel Hill. 11 stops, about 2 km on foot.
summaries.pl: Klasyczna Droga Królewska przez Stare Miasto w Krakowie: od Barbakanu i Bramy Floriańskiej przez Rynek Główny, a dalej ulicami Grodzką i Kanoniczą aż na Wawel. 11 przystanków, około 2 km pieszo.
summaries.zh: 穿越克拉科夫老城的经典皇家之路：从瓮城和圣福里安门出发，穿过中央集市广场，再沿格罗兹卡街和咏祷司铎街走上瓦维尔山。共11站，步行约2公里。

summariesReview: en drafted by the agent; pl and zh are agent drafts not yet checked by a native speaker
namesSource: Short display names curated for the app; pl and zh follow the Wikidata labels (zh label without the "(克拉科夫)" disambiguation suffix).
estMinutesBasis: OSRM foot, listed order, stop to stop: 2,048 m / 27.4 min (data/raw/osrm/stop-pairs-foot.json) + dwell 1620 s (27 min) = 54.4 min, rounded up to 55. The lead's map-meta.json route (2,497 m / 33 min) is longer because its pins sit on the walking network, not at the buildings.
coordinateMethod: lat/lng = Wikidata P625 unless coordinateSource says otherwise. Each stop is cross-checked against (a) its pin in docs/design/map/map-meta.json, converted linearly with that file's image bbox [19.929, 50.0525, 19.947, 50.0675] and 1000x1289 px size, and (b) the centroid of the OSM element tagged with the same wikidata= in data/raw/osm/oldtown-tile*.osm.gz. flag = map pin more than 40 m away; the note explains each flag.
radiiNote: Draft values for review. Default 35 m; Main Square (Rynek) stops 50-70 m; Wawel 60 m (ARCHITECTURE: Wawel courtyard 60); approachRadiusM 110 (ARCHITECTURE default). Every radius exceeds the stop's OSRM snap distance (coordinateCheck.osrmSnapM, distance to the nearest walkable way). The Rynek circles overlap (Cloth Hall 70 m and the Mickiewicz Monument 50 m are 31 m apart), so the engine must arm only the next planned stop.

coordinateCheck.note: FLAG 40 m: Q743704 'Wawel' (the hill complex) is used instead of Q18820 'Wawel Castle' because the stop covers the cathedral and the castle. Wikidata P625 is the open square south of the cathedral; the map pin is the cathedral forecourt 40 m to the north. The OSM label node (88 m) and the castle outline centroid (105 m east) are not good walking targets. The 60 m radius (ARCHITECTURE 'Wawel courtyard 60') covers both the Wikidata point and the map pin.
